item.title: Prose
item.description:
@tailwindcss/typography

View on GitHub!

Beautiful typographic defaults for HTML you don’t control.

The official Tailwind CSS Typography plugin provides a set of prose classes you can use to add beautiful typographic defaults to any vanilla HTML you don’t control, like HTML rendered from Markdown, or pulled from a CMS.

Tailwind CSS IntelliSense extension for Visual Studio Code

<article class="prose lg:prose-xl">
  {{ markdown }}
</article>

To see what it looks like in action, check out our live demo on Tailwind Play. ​

item.title: Resources
item.description:
Here are some external resources that you might find useful:

  • DeFlock - A hub for education, mapping, and more resources related to Flock and ALPR.
  • DeFlock MPLS - A Minneapolis-specific DeFlock effort.
  • SLP ALPR Policy - The official policy document for ALPR use in St. Louis Park.
  • SLP Flock Transparency Portal - A Flock data transparency portal published for St. Louis Park.
  • Rural Privacy ALPR Toolkit - Templates and tutorials to help push back against ALPR.
  • Flock Privacy Request Portal - A portal to submit privacy requests to Flock.
